pages.text: $(l)$(d)Witchcraft!$()$(br2)For those seeking the path of the witch, you need not look further.$(br2)Tame crows to do your bidding. Deliver messages by owl. Ride your very own broom. Eschew that brewing stand and use a cauldron like a $(o)proper$() witch!$(br2)Become the witch of your$(br)  dreams!
The Book of Shadows will guide your way through the magical world of Hexerei, helping you uncover the secrets and powers of witchcraft.

Sage seeds can be found occasionally when breaking grass. Sage is a very useful herb in witchery as it is used to cleanse the area of evil spirits. The seeds are need as well to craft the Book of Shadows.
